root_cause.text: A race condition in the iomap buffered I/O subsystem where `iomap_finish_folio_read()` dereferences `folio->mapping` for error reporting after decrementing `read_bytes_pending`, allowing concurrent truncate logic to clear the mapping pointer while the folio is unlocked.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description details a race scenario where CPU0 preempts after decrementing `read_bytes_pending` but before reporting the error, allowing CPU1 to finish the read and unlock the folio via `folio_end_read()`, which permits CPU2 to truncate and set `folio->mapping` to NULL before CPU0 executes `fserror_report_io(folio->mapping->host, ...)`; the patch resolves this by moving the error reporting call to occur before the `read_bytes_pending` decrement in `fs/iomap/buffered-io.c`.
